_about: One source for the per-app connect steps: /get-started renders each app's list from here (hack_connect_steps.go), and the Website screen (participant-website.js) and the Account screen (account.js) show the tab apps with the publish/connect steps below. html is our own trusted markup. The address-by-URL method ("connect") works on every instance, hosted or self-hosted. An app that also has a hosted-only directory/browse path (Claude's connector directory) carries it separately as "connect_hosted", shown instead of "connect" only on the canonical hosted instance (location.origin === 'https://simple-hack.app'; get-started.html picks the same way, server-side, via its own <!--sh:hosted-->/<!--sh:self--> markers), with "fallback" appended after it as the by-URL escape hatch. A step with "command" is a copy box built from a command template, {address} replaced with mcp_address (or, client-side, the viewer's own origin + mcp_path).
signin_hint: Sign in with {email}, the email you use here, so {app} can see your team.

publish.html: Paste this into a new chat. {app} builds the page and publishes it to your team site.
Watch this page. It says Connected as soon as {app} reaches your team, and Published when the site is live.
